settings.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 4 characters.
settings.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Please sign in again.
settings.hifTokensDesc: Matches the web client; cached per account and refreshed in the background, so it never blocks a request or the first token.
settings.warmUpOnStartupDesc: Only accounts that already hold a token are warmed. When off, an account signs in on the first request that actually needs it, so a restart does not sign the whole pool in at once.
settings.persistTokensDesc: Off by default: tokens live in memory only and a restart signs in again. Turn it on when the sign-in endpoint refuses this deployment (RISK_DEVICE_DETECTED) — a restart then keeps working. The trade-off is a live session credential inside config.json, so mind the file permissions.
settings.thinkingInjectionDesc: Disabled by default. When enabled, append a structured <think> checklist to the latest user message before prompt assembly.
settings.thinkingInjectionPromptHelp: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt shown as the input placeholder.
settings.autoRouteVisionDesc: When enabled, requests to non-vision models that contain images are automatically routed to the vision model for this turn.
settings.currentInputFileDesc: Disabled by default. Once the character threshold is reached, upload the full context as a DS2API_HISTORY.txt context file.
settings.currentInputFileHelp: Default is 0, which uses independent split for any non-empty input.
settings.currentInputFileWarning: Expert mode does not support file uploads; only effective in quick mode
settings.expertPromptSegmentDesc: Only applies to expert models. When the prompt exceeds the character threshold, it is automatically split at role boundaries and sent in segments: earlier segments are sent and then stopped, the final segment returns normally.
settings.expertPromptSegmentMaxCharsHelp: Default 160000. Segmentation triggers when this is exceeded.
settings.autoDeleteDesc: Choose how DeepSeek remote chat records are cleaned up after each request completes.
settings.autoDeleteNoneDesc: Keep the remote session after the request completes.
settings.autoDeleteSingleDesc: Delete only the remote session created by this request.
settings.autoDeleteAllDesc: Delete every remote session for the account after the request completes.
settings.autoDeleteWarning: This mode deletes remote chat records. Use with caution.
